steps.description: Analyze current Profile input logic for mobile and plan country code dropdown integration.
steps.details: Review current Profile component logic for storing mobile number, determine UI and storage model for (country code + mobile), and ensure clean separation in state and saving logic.
steps.expected_changes: Full enhancement plan for country code dropdown, validation, and feedback for the Profile tab.

steps.description: Add/configure a CountryCodeDropdown as reusable React component with flag icons.
steps.details: Create or update the CountryCodeDropdown inline component rendering flag + code in dropdown, using emoji-flags for visual consistency.
steps.expected_changes: Create/adjust a country code selector with flag icons for use inside the Profile edit form.

steps.description: Enforce validation: Require exactly 10-digit mobile, ensure coupling of country code and mobile field if either is set.
steps.details: Update Profile state management, ensure clear error messaging if invalid, and update input to restrict to [0-9] and 10 digits only.
steps.expected_changes: Enforce digit restriction, update profile save validation, and show feedback if user enters an incorrect number or does not select code.

steps.description: Change storage model: Save country code + mobile as separate fields, and always display both if present.
steps.details: Update save (localStorage) and load logic to ensure the two fields persist correctly, and update display.
steps.expected_changes: Persist and restore both fields, using the new model.

steps.description: Polish: Accessibility, feedback, placeholder, and usage instructions.
steps.details: Update ARIA labels, add instructive placeholder, ensure feedback is easily visible.
steps.expected_changes: Accessibility and UX tweaks as part of edit form logic.

assumptions: Only App.js needs modifications for Profile tab logic and rendering; styling is handled inline or by main stylesheet.
No changes needed to preferences or provider logic as mobile/country code are for profile only.
A limited, curated set of country codes/flags will be used for UX simplicity.
